comment: Intentional protocol changes, each keyed by the name check_protocol.py prints and valued with the reason and the GOAT change that adopts it. Keep empty unless GOAT has adopted the change.

tools.get_browser_state: cua-driver#134 adds optional origin_scope (array of origins) to this browser tool's inputSchema; the schema already allowed additional properties, so the checker cannot prove the addition is additive. GOAT cannot be broken: its pinned capability manifest excludes every browser_* tool and get_browser_state (packages/shared/src/cuaDriverManifest.ts), so GOAT never calls it; GOAT adopts origin_scope in its browser-claim work (lane F).

tools.click: Upstream sync (trycua/cua 33a57bb0a, niri adapter) adds maximum: 3 to click's count on Linux and clamps a larger count to a triple click at run time (click_train), because a niri click train is rechecked only once, before its first press, so count: 20 would mean seconds of ungated presses. The tightening only bounds count; every other argument is unchanged. GOAT cannot be broken: its Linux helper sends count 2 for doubleClick (apps/server/src/cua/linuxHelper/linuxActions.ts) and screen-code tab clicks already accept only 1, 2 or 3 (apps/server/src/screenCode/ScreenTargetPrelude.ts); a larger count is clamped, not refused.
